bullets: BASIC SEE, TALK & TOSS FEATURES INCLUDED, NO SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED - Included features: 1080p live view, 360° rotating view, barking alerts, 2-way audio, color night vision, and treat tossing. Does not include premium AI-powered smart alerts from Furbo Nanny subscription. This model is ready to use out of the box, no subscription needed.

FULL HD 360° ROTATING PET SECURITY CAM - Best-in-class 1080p video with a motorized 360° rotating view covers your entire room, day or night. Use 4x zoom to check in on your dog from anywhere via the Furbo app. Know what’s going on in your home from anywhere - no more missed moments or blind spots with your Furbo pet cam.

REAL-TIME 2-WAY AUDIO & COLOR NIGHT VISION - Seamlessly hear and speak with pets and family members at home, with in-app volume control for crystal clear audio. INSTANT BARKING ALERTS - Basic barking alerts help you know if your dog needs you. Furbo’s BARKING SENSOR detects when your dog is barking to send a real-time notification to your smartphone.

FUN ADJUSTABLE TREAT TOSSING - Toss treats to your dog remotely with the free Furbo iOS/Android app via the Furbo dog treat dispenser camera. Customize the treat size to fit your dog’s needs. Fill the treat dispenser with their favorite treats to use as a reward, or to help redirect behaviors associated with separation anxiety, such as barking, pacing, or excessive licking

14-DAY TRIAL FOR ADVANCED FEATURES - Want access to advanced features? New users can try Furbo Nanny free for 14 days to trial AI-powered alerts, video history, daily reports, Nanny Chat, Calm My Pet, and more. Furbo Nanny features are not included with the camera after the trial ends, but you can subscribe anytime or continue using the included basic camera features at no cost.

EASY SETUP, SECURE CONNECTION: 1) Plug in Furbo using the included USB cable (note: USB power adapter not included). 2) Download the Furbo app. 3) Create an account and connect to 2.4GHz WiFi (5GHz not supported). 4) Start using your camera and enjoy a 14-day free trial of Furbo Nanny—upgrade anytime! Furbo uses bank-level encryption and recommends 2-step verification for added security.
ALREADY A FURBO USER? - If you already use Furbo Nanny, adding multiple cameras to the same account requires an upgrade. Need help? Contact Furbo Support.
